# 2 Baruch Chapter 37 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**37:1** And I prayed and said: O Lord my God, you are able to interpret for me this vision which I have seen.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. Single-verse chapter; all three largely agree. PNEUMA's "please interpret" omits the "you are able" clause that expresses confidence in God's capacity; LOGOS/EMET preserved this.*
